name: get_availability
description: Fetch real calendar availability for the next 7 days. Use only for explicit scheduling or booking requests after the caller finishes the day or time preference, and pass the caller's scheduling request so the backend can filter the options.

name: book_meeting
description: Book a meeting only after confirming one exact slot from the available options. Pass the caller's exact confirmation words in selection, do not book from vague confirmations, and do not invent a new date.
